newsitem.title: USA: Kuhlman sets new shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Kuhlman sets new shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Kuhlman Corp said Thursday that its board had adopted a shareholder rights plan to replace an existing rights plan that expires April 30.
The board declared a dividend distribution of one preferred stock purchase right on each outstanding share to shareholders of record April 30, 1997, the company said.
It said the rights expire April 30, 2007, unless redeemed earlier at $0.001 per right.
Kuhlman is a holding company whose business segments make and sell electrical and industrial products such as turbochargers and engine cooling fans.
